visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark shoulder-length hair and bangs appears in a medium close-up, wearing a white lace top. She is smiling and holding a black-and-white cat against her chest; red hand-drawn text 'Make up' is overlaid. (2) The camera shifts to a closer framing of the woman's face as she speaks directly to the lens, exhibiting a cheerful facial expression. (3) She holds a small, circular black cosmetic pot with a white logo over her left eye, then brings it down to show it clearly to the viewer. (4) Close-up shot showing the underside of the product, revealing a red label with white text, followed by an interior view of the pot showing a dark reddish-brown creamy substance that has been partially used. (5) The woman applies dots of the reddish cream to her cheeks, forehead, nose, and chin using her fingertip; she then blends the product into her skin with upward circular motions, smiling as her complexion brightens. (6) In the final phase, she poses by tilting her head, touching her hair and face, and holding the cosmetic pot near her cheek to showcase the finished natural makeup look.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Variety]: Make up ♡. (2) [Subtitle]: 最近有人問我的日常妝容 Recently, someone asked me about my daily makeup routine. (3) [Slogan]: CHANEL 3. VITAL BEIGE. (4) [Subtitle]: 這個超厲害 This is awesome. (5) [Subtitle]: 色號是3號 The color number is No. 3. (6) [Subtitle]: 這個我用了半年多，用到見底了 I have used this for more than half a year, and it's almost empty. (7) [Subtitle]: 我現在呢只有上底妝 I'm only wearing foundation as my base makeup. (8) [Subtitle]: 忍了這麼久終於來跟你們分享囉 I've held it in for so long! Finally sharing it with you all! (12) [Subtitle]: 是不是超級好用？超級透亮的！ Isn't it amazing? My face looks super radiant!

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A young female voice speaks with a friendly and clear tone, introducing a topic over a gentle acoustic guitar BGM with male vocals singing in English. (2) The voice-over continues at a moderate pace, describing a product while the rhythmic acoustic BGM maintains a steady, upbeat tempo. (3) During the middle phase, the speech stops briefly, allowing the melodic guitar and light percussion of the BGM to become more prominent, accompanied by subtle breathy cheerful vocalizations. (4) The female voice returns for a final narrative sequence, sounding enthusiastic and assertive, ending as the BGM fades out naturally.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a beauty tutorial and product endorsement, specifically showcasing a Chanel lip and cheek balm. The creator uses a personal vlog style to recommend the product, demonstrating its application and effectiveness in achieving a natural, healthy glow to her audience.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of product branding, mention of color number, and positive testimonial about long-term use.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A highly effective short-form beauty advertisement that blends lifestyle elements (pet ownership) with professional product demonstration.
